title: 第10章  连你师傅都敢骗？
content_zh:
午时，烈日当空！
灵药峰的半山腰处，几百株银龙草已经整整齐齐种下，铺满这一块空地。
银色灵药绽放丝丝光芒，引人注目，丝丝灵气环绕四周，许久不曾散去。
“种一上午了，休息一会吧！”
苏烬生见林月舒累得层层细汗渗出，吐气如兰，不由得出声道。
他本身就是身强力壮，再加上有着炼气五重境的实力，这点杂活连大气都不带喘的。
但是林月舒只有炼气一重境，体内灵气几乎可以忽略不计，干了半天下来，早已累的气喘吁吁。
“休息一会，休息一会！”
“看起来还挺轻松的活，怎么干起来这么累呢！”
苏烬生并未言语，只是脸上露出一个淡然的笑容，丢过去了五块下品灵石。
“这灵石你拿着吞噬，先恢复一番灵气，等休息够了再接着干活！”
林月舒并未推辞，接过灵石之后，便直接开始吞噬了起来。
因为她丹田内的灵气是一点都不剩了，若是再不吞噬灵气的话。
下午的活恐怕是一点也干不了了。
苏烬生见状，也是拿出了几枚下品灵石开始吞噬了起来。
如今他才刚突破炼气五重境不久，丹田空虚，需要大量的灵气填补才行！
丹田运转，大量的灵气涌入丹田，不到半刻钟时间，两枚下品灵石就已经被吞噬干净。
没有犹豫，翻手间，便又是两枚下品灵石出现在了手中，继而吞噬了起来。
“师傅，那两个种植灵药的杂役弟子来了后，便踩坏了许多银龙草，并且还将我打伤！”
“我见您正在炼制丹药，所以未敢上前打扰！”

廉妄言的声音不大，带着几分委屈，述说出声。
“这个时候，那两个杂役弟子估计已经逃走了！”
“所以，我建议直接上报宗门，将那两个杂役弟子逐出宗门，并得到相应的处罚！”
这令人厌恶的声音入耳，林月舒眉头瞬间拧成一团，停下修炼，起身走至苏烬生一侧。
而苏烬生的面色也是凝重几分，将手中灵石收入储物戒之中，站立起身，循声望去。
只见，廉妄言的身前，乃是一位头发花白的老者。
这老者面色阴沉，目光如炬，一言不发的迈动步伐，强悍的气势随之而动，席卷而至。
白色衣袍加身，更加彰显气质！
这人便是紫幕神山唯一一位四品炼丹师，张清玄！
原本刚刚炼制出一炉丹药，心情还算不错，廉妄言却告知他银龙草被踩死大片。
这让他心中瞬间涌出汹涌怒意！
要知道，这银龙草想要移植活可不容易，且炼制多种丹药都需要用到。
如今灵药峰中的银龙草已经告急了。
所以才让胡羽丰派两名杂役弟子前来帮忙移植。
谁曾想，非但没有帮助移植，反而损坏了不少。
今日，若不让那两个杂役弟子付出点代价，他这灵药峰长老也就没有必要做了！
“杂役弟子，苏烬生，林月舒，见过长老！”
苏烬生神色凝重，将林月舒护在身后，毕恭毕敬的开口出声。
而张药师在见到苏烬生之后，也是微微一愣，显然没有想到。
前来移植的杂役弟子竟然会是当初的那个天才，内门弟子第一人！

当初他与苏烬生有过几面之缘，知晓其为人性格，应当不会是无缘无故损坏灵药才对。
难道这其中有其他缘由？
“苏烬生，你踩死大片银龙草，导致灵药峰损失惨重，你该当何罪！”
廉妄言见到苏烬生二人竟然未曾离去，心中顿时涌现出一阵喜意，当场便呵斥出声。
根据他的了解，接下来自己这个暴躁的师尊便会直接出手，好好教训苏烬生一番。
然后则由他把苏烬生抬下山峰！
“你胡说，这银龙草明明都是你踩死的，跟我们有什么关系？”
“使灵药峰损失惨重的，也是你才对！”
林月舒虽然境界不高，但也不是吃亏的主，直接开口反驳出声。
“在我师尊面前，竟然还敢信口雌黄，栽赃陷害与我！”
廉妄言眼底闪过一分慌乱之色，心头一紧，不由得连忙出声。
“真是罪加一等！”
“住嘴！”
张药师脸上露出一副不耐烦的神色，直接厉喝出声，随即将目光落到了苏烬生身上，诧异道。
“你的丹田恢复了？”
“嗯！”
苏烬生见到张药师并不暴躁，心中不由得松了口气，点了点头，应道出声。
闻言，张药师心中涌现出几分喜色，一个天才重现，对于他们紫幕神山来说，可是一大幸事。
当初苏烬生境界跌落，他在暗地里可是一阵可惜。
如今虽然需要重头修炼，但好过一直当废材！

“苏烬生，你来说，这是怎么回事？”
此言一出，身旁廉妄言的面色瞬间阴沉到了极致，心中恐惧之色涌动。
真是奇怪，一向暴躁的师尊，怎么在今日如此平静了？
不行！绝对不能让苏烬生将真相说出来，否则，他就该吃不了兜着走了。
“师尊！”
“就是苏烬生踩死的银龙草，我可是亲眼所见啊！”
“你不能不信我啊！”
“啪！！”
张药师眉头一皱，翻手就是一巴掌扇了过去，清脆的响亮声回荡四周，令得全场瞬间寂静了下来。
紧接着，爆喝之声便已传出。
“再敢多嘴，我打断你一条腿！”
廉妄言一只手捂着肿如猪的脸颊，一只手在嘴边接过带有血迹的牙齿。
双目红润，一副想哭哭不出的表情，不敢再多嘴半句。
林月舒见状眉头不由得轻轻皱起，真不敢想象，这一巴掌下来，脸得多痛啊。
苏烬生心中顿感解气，随即便将事情的来龙去脉说了出来。
“廉妄言见我师妹貌美，便要轻薄于我师妹，被我阻止打伤后，便踩死了大片的银龙草，而后上山去了！”
张药师闻言，便将目光落到了林月舒的身上，而后又看了看廉妄言。
心中大概已经明了此事的是非对错！
毕竟，自己徒弟是什么尿性，他还是清楚的。
当即，心中怒火中烧，翻手间便又是一个巴掌打了过去！

“啪！！”
这一巴掌比刚才更狠。
廉妄言直接在原地转了几个圈，而后便摔倒在了地上。
带着牙齿的鲜血再次从口中吐出，两边的脸肿得跟猪头一样，看不出原本模样。
他感觉不到疼痛，只是感觉到了阵阵麻木！
“连你师傅都敢骗，你这个欺师忘祖的东西！”
张药师一副气愤之色，怒喝出声，抬腿就要踢去。
“等一下！师傅！”
廉妄言恍惚间，看到了远处种植好的银龙草，心中顿生一计，连忙出声道。
“这些银龙草真的不是我踩死的！”
“我原本在勤勤恳恳的种植银龙草，转头发现他们两个踩死了大片的银龙草！”
“我上前理论，却被打伤！”
“若是不信的话，你看那片种植好的银龙草地，就是我所种植的！”
闻言，张药师也不由得将目光投了过去，当看到远处种植好的几百株银龙草之后，顿时愣在了原地！
content_en:
At noon, the scorching sun is in the sky!
Halfway up the mountainside of Spiritual Medicine Peak, hundreds of Silver Dragon Grass plants have been planted neatly, covering the open space.
The silver elixir bloomed with gleams of light, attracting everyone's attention, and strands of aura surrounded it, never dissipating for a long time.
"I've been planting all morning, let's take a rest!"
Su Jinsheng couldn't help but sigh when he saw Lin Yueshu was so tired that she was sweating in layers and exhaling like blue.
He is physically strong, and with the strength of the fifth level of Qi refining, he can do this chore without even breathing.
But Lin Yueshu was only at the first level of Qi Refining, and the spiritual energy in his body was almost negligible. After working for a long time, he was already panting from exhaustion.
"Take a rest, take a rest!"
"It seems like a pretty easy job, why is it so tiring!"
Su Jinsheng didn't say anything, but showed a calm smile on his face and threw five low-grade spiritual stones.
"Take this spiritual stone and devour it to restore some spiritual energy first, and then continue working after you have had enough rest!"
Lin Yueshu didn't refuse. After taking the spirit stone, he started to devour it.
Because there is no spiritual energy left in her Dantian, if she does not swallow the spiritual energy.
I'm afraid I won't be able to do any work in the afternoon.
Seeing this, Su Jinsheng also took out a few low-grade spiritual stones and started to devour them.
Now that he has just broken through to the fifth level of Qi refining, his Dantian is empty and needs a lot of spiritual energy to fill it!
The dantian was moving, and a large amount of spiritual energy poured into the dantian. In less than half a quarter of an hour, the two low-grade spiritual stones had been swallowed up.
Without hesitation, in the blink of an eye, two more low-grade spiritual stones appeared in his hands, and they were swallowed.
"Master, when the two handyman disciples who planted elixirs came, they trampled a lot of silver dragon grass and injured me!"
"I saw you were refining the elixir, so I didn't dare to disturb you!"
Lian Wangyan's voice was not loud, and he spoke out loud with a bit of grievance.
"At this time, the two handyman disciples have probably escaped!"
"So, I suggest reporting it directly to the sect, expelling those two handyman disciples from the sect, and receiving corresponding punishments!"
After hearing this disgusting voice, Lin Yueshu frowned instantly, stopped practicing, stood up and walked to Su Jinsheng's side.
Su Jinsheng's expression was also serious. He put the spirit stone in his hand into the storage ring, stood up, and took it out.
I saw an old man with gray hair standing in front of Lian Huanyan.
The old man's face was gloomy, his eyes were as bright as a torch, and he took steps without saying a word, followed by a powerful momentum that swept over him.
Add a white robe to show your temperament even more!
This person is the only fourth-grade alchemist in the Purple Curtain Mountain, Zhang Qingxuan!
He had just refined a batch of elixirs and was in a good mood, but Lian Huanyan informed him that Silver Dragon Grass had been trampled to death.
This caused a surge of anger in his heart instantly!
You must know that it is not easy to transplant this silver dragon grass, and it needs to be used to refine a variety of elixirs.
Now the Silver Dragon Grass in the Spiritual Medicine Peak is in critical condition.
That's why Hu Yufeng sent two handyman disciples to help with the transplant.
Who would have thought that instead of helping the transplant, it actually damaged a lot.
Today, if the two handyman disciples were not made to pay a price, there would be no need for him, the elder of Spiritual Medicine Peak, to do anything!
"Common servant disciples, Su Jinsheng and Lin Yueshu, have met the elders!"
Su Jinsheng looked solemn, protected Lin Yueshu behind him, and spoke respectfully.
After seeing Su Jinsheng, Pharmacist Zhang was slightly stunned, obviously not expecting it.
The handyman disciple who came for the transplant turned out to be the original genius, the number one inner disciple!
He had met Su Jinsheng several times before, and knowing his character, he would not have destroyed the elixir for no reason.
Is there any other reason for this?
"Su Jinsheng, you trampled to death a large area of Silver Dragon Grass and caused heavy losses to the Spiritual Medicine Peak. What crime do you deserve!"
Honest liesSeeing that Su Jinsheng and the others had not left, a burst of joy suddenly emerged in his heart, and he scolded them on the spot.
According to his understanding, his irritable master would directly take action to teach Su Jinsheng a lesson.
Then he would carry Su Jinsheng down the mountain!
"You're talking nonsense. You obviously stepped on this Silver Dragon Grass to death. What does it have to do with us?"
"It's you who caused the elixir peak to suffer heavy losses!"
Although Lin Yueshu was not at a high level, he was not the one who suffered the loss, so he directly retorted.
"In front of my master, you actually dare to talk nonsense and frame me!"
A look of panic flashed across Lian Wangyan's eyes, his heart tightened, and he couldn't help but speak out quickly.
"It's really a crime plus another level!"
"Shut up!"
An impatient look appeared on Yaoshi Zhang's face, and he shouted loudly. Then he turned his eyes to Su Jinsheng and said in surprise.
"Has your Dantian recovered?"
"Yeah!"
Seeing that Yaoshi Zhang was not irritable, Su Jinsheng couldn't help but feel relieved, nodded, and responded.
Hearing this, Zhang Yaoshi felt a little joyful in his heart. The reappearance of a genius was a great blessing for their Purple Curtain Mountain.
When Su Jinsheng's level fell, he secretly felt a pity.
Although I need to practice again now, it is better than being a waste all the time!
"Su Jinsheng, tell me, what's going on?"
As soon as these words came out, the face of Lian Wangyan next to him instantly darkened to the extreme, and fear surged in his heart.
It's really strange, how come Master, who has always been violent, is so calm today?
no! Su Jinsheng must not be allowed to tell the truth, otherwise, he will be left with nothing to eat.
"Master!"
"It's the Silver Dragon Grass that Su Jinsheng trampled to death. I saw it with my own eyes!"
"You have to believe me!"
"Crack!!"
Zhang Yaoshi frowned and slapped him with a flip of his hand. The clear and loud sound echoed around, causing the whole place to fall silent instantly.
Immediately afterwards, the sound of loud shouting was heard.
"If you dare to talk any more, I'll break one of your legs!"
Lian Wangyan covered his pig-swollen cheek with one hand, and took the bloody teeth near his mouth with one hand.
His eyes were red, and he looked like he wanted to cry, but he didn't dare to say another word.
Lin Yueshu couldn't help but frown slightly when she saw this. She really couldn't imagine how painful this slap would be on her face.
Su Jinsheng felt relieved and immediately told the whole story.
"Lian Wang said that when he saw my junior sister's beauty, he wanted to be scornful of my junior sister. After I stopped him from getting injured, he trampled to death a large piece of silver dragon grass and then went up the mountain!"
Hearing this, Pharmacist Zhang turned his attention to Lin Yueshu, and then looked at Lian Wangyan.
I probably already know the right and wrong of this matter in my heart!
After all, he still knows what kind of urine his apprentice is.
Immediately, my heart was filled with anger, and I slapped him with another slap in my hand!
"Crack!!"
This slap was harder than before.
Lian Wangyan spun around a few times and then fell to the ground.
The blood with the teeth spit out from the mouth again, and the face on both sides was swollen like a pig's head, and the original appearance could not be seen.
He felt no pain, just waves of numbness!
"You dare to lie to your master, you deceiver and forgets his ancestors!"
Zhang Yaoshi looked angry, yelled angrily, and raised his leg to kick him away.
"Wait a minute! Master!"
Lian Huanyan was in a trance and saw the silver dragon grass planted in the distance. He suddenly had a plan in his mind and hurriedly spoke out.
"I really didn't step on these silver dragon grasses to death!"
"I was diligently planting silver dragon grass, but when I turned around, I found that the two of them had trampled a large area of silver dragon grass to death!"
"I stepped forward to argue, but I was injured!"
"If you don't believe it, look at the planted Silver Dragon grassland, it was planted by me!"
Hearing this, Zhang Yaoshi couldn't help but turn his eyesThe light shone through, and when he saw hundreds of Silver Dragon Grass plants planted in the distance, he froze in place!
